scripts.dev: npm run build -w @geostrata/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @geostrata/server" "npm run dev -w @geostrata/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @geostrata/shared && npm run build -w @geostrata/server && npm run build -w @geostrata/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @geostrata/shared && npm run typecheck -w @geostrata/server && npm run typecheck -w @geostrata/web
